notes.title: Patch 1.003
notes.notes:
Feature: You can now rejoin a multiplayer match in case you lost the connection.
 Feature: The player list now shows who has and hasn't already made their choice.
 Bugfix: Fixed a bug that caused a multiplayer match to get stuck when a player lost connection.
 Bugfix: Fixed an issue where the 10K points achievement could not be obtained.
 Bugfix: Fixed a possible crash when multiple players reset their turn.

notes.title: Patch 1.002
notes.notes:
Feature: Added game instructions via a new option that is availabe both in the title screen and ingame.
 Improvement: Improved the end game statistics panel.
 Bugfix: Fixed a bug that cause a tutorial hint to appear when another hint was already visible.
 Bugfix: Fixed several translation issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.001
notes.notes:
Improvement: Just like in multiplayer, AI opponents now have really cool random names in singleplayer, too
 Bugfix: When clicking "Back to main menu" a new game started instead
